This game is a really hard-fought draw against Matt Ball, an acclaimed chess author. I was playing Board 2 in the Herts & District final (Welwyn-Hatfield vs St Albans) and was under pressure the whole game. The draw was critical for our Welwyn-Hatfield to win the match and the cup.

title: Edoardo Mancini
text:
About Me
I am a Senior Data Scientist working at Roche in the UK. My work involves leading statistical programming activities in early and late-stage clinical trials. I am also a passionate advocate for R and Open Source, and am able to pursue these interests in my current role as maintainer for the {admiral} R package.
Outside of work, I enjoy playing chess, reading, and running.
